lyrics.ja: アンドロイドガール
lyrics.romaji: Andoroido Gaaru
lyrics.en: Android girl
lyrics.zh: 機器人女孩

lyrics.ja: もういっそ "一緒ランド" 作りましょ 君とマッチアップ 乗っかって
lyrics.romaji: Mou Isso "Issho Rando" Tsukurimasho Kimi to Macchi Appu Nokkatte
lyrics.en: Let's just make a "Together Land"—match up with you and hop on
lyrics.zh: 乾脆來打造「一起樂園」吧，與你配對乘上

lyrics.ja: 「構ってもっと 足りないの」歌え 想い出染みた嫉妬の style
lyrics.romaji: 「Kamatte Motto Tarinai no」 Utae Omoide Shimita Shitto no Style
lyrics.en: Sing "Pay more attention to me—it's not enough," a jealousy-stained style soaked in memories
lyrics.zh: 唱著「再理我多一點，不夠啦」，沾染回憶的嫉妒風格

lyrics.ja: 代わる代わる傷付けては 「もうしない」って嘘で仲直りごっこだ
lyrics.romaji: Kawaru Gawaru Kizutsukete ha 「Mou Shinai」 tte Uso de Nakanaori Gokko Da
lyrics.en: Taking turns hurting each other, then making up with the lie of "I won't do it again"
lyrics.zh: 輪流傷害彼此，再用「不會再犯」的謊言玩和好遊戲

lyrics.ja: 勘違いの騙し合い 目を見ればすぐに分かるってバカみたい
lyrics.romaji: Kanchigai no Damashiai Me wo Mireba Sugu ni Wakaru tte Baka Mitai
lyrics.en: A mutual deception of misunderstandings—saying you'd know just by looking into my eyes is so stupid
lyrics.zh: 誤會重重的互相欺騙，說什麼看眼神就懂，像個傻瓜

lyrics.ja: "妄想" に好きって言うほど この愛は腐ってるんだよ
lyrics.romaji: "Mousou" ni Suki tte Iu Hodo Kono Ai ha Kusatteru n Da yo
lyrics.en: The more you say you love a "delusion," the more this love rots
lyrics.zh: 越是對「妄想」說喜歡，這份愛就越腐爛

lyrics.ja: 早く気付いてくれよ
lyrics.romaji: Hayaku Kizuite Kure yo
lyrics.en: Hurry up and notice
lyrics.zh: 快點察覺吧

lyrics.ja: アンドロイドガール をかしくなっちゃった
lyrics.romaji: Andoroido Gaaru Okashiku Natchatta
lyrics.en: Android girl—something's gone wrong
lyrics.zh: 機器人女孩，變得不對勁了

lyrics.ja: 僕だけのものになった君は "誰" なの?
lyrics.romaji: Boku Dake no Mono ni Natta Kimi ha "Dare" na no?
lyrics.en: Now that you've become mine alone, who are you?
lyrics.zh: 成了只屬於我的你，究竟是「誰」？

lyrics.ja: ずっとずっと信じてきたのにな
lyrics.romaji: Zutto Zutto Shinjite Kita no ni na
lyrics.en: I believed in you all this time, and yet
lyrics.zh: 明明一直一直相信著你

lyrics.ja: アンドロイドガール 想いはなんだっけ
lyrics.romaji: Andoroido Gaaru Omoi ha Nan Dakke
lyrics.en: Android girl—what were these feelings again?
lyrics.zh: 機器人女孩，這份感情是什麼來著

lyrics.ja: 君とのキスが痛くて息を閉じたの ずっとずっと
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to no Kisu ga Itakute Iki wo Tojita no Zutto Zutto
lyrics.en: Your kisses hurt so much I held my breath, always, always
lyrics.zh: 與你的吻疼痛得讓我屏住呼吸，一直一直

lyrics.ja: 何度愛を再起動したって
lyrics.romaji: Nando Ai wo Saikidou Shitatte
lyrics.en: No matter how many times I reboot this love
lyrics.zh: 無論重啟多少次這份愛

lyrics.ja: ちょっとだって変われなどしないよ
lyrics.romaji: Chotto Datte Kaware Nado Shinai yo
lyrics.en: It won't change even a little
lyrics.zh: 連一點點都無法改變

lyrics.ja: 「あぁ可愛いね どうしてくれよう」
lyrics.romaji: 「Aa Kawaii ne Doushite Kureyou」
lyrics.en: "Ah, you're so cute—what should I do with you?"
lyrics.zh: 「啊，真可愛呢，該拿你怎麼辦」

lyrics.ja: もう疲れた ドキドキさせるお世辞の resize
lyrics.romaji: Mou Tsukareta Dokidoki Saseru Oseji no Resize
lyrics.en: I'm tired of resizing these heart-fluttering flatteries
lyrics.zh: 已經累了，那些令人心跳的奉承話不斷調整大小

lyrics.ja: 鬱雑い鬱雑いの併合罪 どう期待していいのか分からなくなったよ
lyrics.romaji: Uzai Uzai no Heigouzai Dou Kitai Shite Ii no ka Wakaranaku Natta yo
lyrics.en: The combined crime of annoyance upon annoyance—I no longer know how to hope
lyrics.zh: 煩人加煩人的合併罪，已經不知道該如何期待了

lyrics.ja: エンドロールはまだですか どこにいても一緒だなんてまじで痛い
lyrics.romaji: Endo Rooru ha Mada Desu ka Doko ni Ite mo Issho Da Nante Maji de Itai
lyrics.en: Is the end roll not here yet? "Together wherever we are"—that seriously hurts
lyrics.zh: 片尾字幕還沒到嗎，「無論在哪都在一起」這種話真的痛

lyrics.ja: "感傷"に浸っていいかな あの頃を願っていいかな
lyrics.romaji: "Kanshou" ni Hitatte Ii Kana Ano Koro wo Negatte Ii Kana
lyrics.en: Is it okay to wallow in sentimentality? Is it okay to wish for those days?
lyrics.zh: 可以沉浸在感傷中嗎，可以祈願回到那時候嗎

lyrics.ja: アリかナシか教えてよ
lyrics.romaji: Ari ka Nashi ka Oshiete yo
lyrics.en: Tell me—yes or no?
lyrics.zh: 告訴我是有還是沒有

lyrics.ja: アンドロイドガール をかしくなっちゃった
lyrics.romaji: Andoroido Gaaru Okashiku Natchatta
lyrics.en: Android girl—something's gone wrong
lyrics.zh: 機器人女孩，變得不對勁了

lyrics.ja: 君だけのものになった "僕" が好きなの?
lyrics.romaji: Kimi Dake no Mono ni Natta "Boku" ga Suki na no?
lyrics.en: Do you love the "me" who became yours alone?
lyrics.zh: 你喜歡的是成了只屬於你的「我」嗎？

lyrics.ja: ずっとずっと騙してきたんだね
lyrics.romaji: Zutto Zutto Damashite Kita n Da ne
lyrics.en: You've been deceiving me all along, haven't you?
lyrics.zh: 一直一直都在騙我呢

lyrics.ja: アンドロイドガール 想いはなんだっけ
lyrics.romaji: Andoroido Gaaru Omoi ha Nan Dakke
lyrics.en: Android girl—what were these feelings again?
lyrics.zh: 機器人女孩，這份感情是什麼來著

lyrics.ja: 錆び憑いた腕で何度僕を求めた? ずっとずっと
lyrics.romaji: Sabitsuita Ude de Nando Boku wo Motometa? Zutto Zutto
lyrics.en: How many times did you reach for me with those rusted arms? Always, always
lyrics.zh: 用生鏽的雙臂尋求了我多少次？一直一直

lyrics.ja: 何度愛を再起動したって
lyrics.romaji: Nando Ai wo Saikidou Shitatte
lyrics.en: No matter how many times I reboot this love
lyrics.zh: 無論重啟多少次這份愛
